objectives: 培養學生以DSP的知識，來訓練其相關的硬體架構設計方面的技能，並使其有能力來分析各種架構間的效能問題。
content:
◎Algorithms Representations
Discussions on Ethics for Engineers.
1. DSP Algorithm
2. Pipelining and Parallel Processing
3. Retiming
◎ASIC DSP
4. Unfolding and Folding
5. Systolic Arrays
6. Finite Word Length Effects
7. Bit-level and Redundant Arithmetic
8. Synchronous and Asynchronous Architecture
◎Programmable DSP
9. DSP Synthesis and CAD
10. Programmable DSP
books:
教科書：VLSI Digital Signal Procesing Systems (author : Keshab K. Parhi)
參考書：DPS Integrated Circuit (author : Lars Wanhammar)
grading_policy:
●Homework & Class Participation : 30%
●Midterm exam : 30%
●Term Project and Presentation : 40%
